humanEvidence.observation: Asesor selector renders empty for Carlos after the R14A roster correction; the same selector had populated advisors for Paula/Dirección.

causalEvidence.r14aAttempt: core/ciclo.js now unwraps route-scoped store before reading asesores, filters active Asesor role, country and deduplicates identities.
causalEvidence.accessPolicy: tenant-access-policy-effective-p0 restricts the asesores/team-directory read to Dirección, SuperAdmin, AdminTenant and Admin through canUseTeamDirectory(). Operativo is not in TEAM_DIRECTORY_ROLES.
causalEvidence.readonlyStore: store-firestore-product-readonly-p0 converts the effective query plan __deny__ constraint into a denied collection and an empty asesores cache.
causalEvidence.demonstratedFailure: Because the canonical asesores collection is never hydrated for Operativo, unwrapping the scoped store cannot recover rows that were denied upstream. R14A fixed route-scope shadowing but not role-authorized assignment-roster hydration.

securityDecision.rule: Do not grant Operativo unrestricted Equipo/team-directory access merely to populate an assignment selector.
securityDecision.requiredAuthority: Create/reuse a minimal canonical assignable-advisor projection/contract containing only fields required for assignment (canonical id, display name, active/assignable state, advisor role eligibility and country compatibility), readable by roles that are allowed to assign work in Ops/Leads.
securityDecision.managementBoundary: Full user/team administration and sensitive account/credential fields remain restricted to authorized administration roles.

requiredFix: Introduce one canonical minimal assignment-roster read owner, not a parallel user master.
Ops/Leads assignment-capable roles, including Operativo when module permissions allow creation/assignment, can hydrate the minimal roster independently of Equipo visibility.
Dirección/Admin continue to receive the same canonical eligible advisor set.
No hardcoded advisors; no duplicate identities; inactive/deleted/projection-only/non-Asesor users excluded.

Exact authenticated Preview must prove Paula/Dirección and Carlos/Operativo parity for the same country and prove Carlos still cannot access restricted full team administration unless separately authorized.
